title: Inverse Kinematics
text: Compute joint configurations to achieve an end-effector pose, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {End effector} sets End-effector name ’tool’; {Rigid body tree}, {Show solution diagnostic outputs} enables info port, {Solver} sets the algorithm for solving inverse kinematics BFGS Gradient, {Enforce joint limits} sets the enforce rigid body tree joint limits, {Maximum iterations} sets the maximum number of iterations, {Maximum time} sets the maximum number of seconds, {Gradient tolerance} sets the threshold on gradient of cost function, {Solution tolerance} sets the threshold on pose, {Step tolerance} sets the minimum step size 1e-14, {Error change tolerance} sets the threshold on change in pose, {Use error damping} enables error damping, {Damping bias} sets the damping on cost function, {Constraint tolerance} sets the threshold of the constraint violations and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Weights
ports.summary: Weights for pose tolerances six-element vector

ports.name: InitialGuess
ports.summary: Initial guess of robot configuration vector

params.name: Rigid body tree
params.values: Rigid body tree model twoJointRigidBodyTree (default) | rigidBodyTree object

params.name: Solver
params.values: Algorithm for solving inverse kinematics BFGS Gradient Projection (default) | Levenberg-Marquardt | fminconsqp

params.name: Enforce joint limits
params.values: Enforce rigid body tree joint limits on (default) | off

params.name: Maximum iterations
params.values: Maximum number of iterations 1500 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Maximum time
params.values: Maximum number of seconds 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Gradient tolerance
params.values: Threshold on gradient of cost function 1e-7 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Solution tolerance
params.values: Threshold on pose error 1e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Error change tolerance
params.values: Threshold on change in pose error 1e-12 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Damping bias
params.values: Damping on cost function 0.0025 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Constraint tolerance
params.values: Threshold of the constraint violations 1e-6 (default) | nonnegative numeric scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
